lead.headline: Russia's huge overnight strike hits Kyiv — missiles land in Poland
lead.summary: Russia fires 400+ drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine overnight, killing at least eight in Kyiv and crippling bridges and power. Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone come down in Poland; PM Tusk calls it a deliberate provocation and NATO calls it a grave violation of airspace.

stories.headline: AI stock rout pushes S&P 500 into correction
stories.summary: US stocks fall 3.7% on Friday as a sell-off in AI and chip shares drags the S&P 500 and the Dow into correction territory.

stories.headline: ICJ: Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice finds Myanmar responsible for genocide; Myanmar and China reject the ruling as unfair.

stories.headline: Trump weighs new Iran strikes as Israel presses
stories.summary: The president weighs another round of extensive strikes on Iran, and tells European leaders to withhold funding from Ukraine after his summit with Putin.

stories.headline: Anthropic opens trading as a $2 trillion company
stories.summary: The Claude maker's market debut lands it among the world's most valuable public companies, days after its record IPO.
